title: Performance budgets and measurement
rule: Adopt the absolute budgets in budgets. PDF has its own deadline and is not the import wall time. Model and tool latency are not borrowed from import or fixture-run time. While trunk has no comparable product code, measure the added operation against these absolute budgets and do not build a trunk comparison. Record workload, sample count, warm or cold state, and the limiter with every probe.
alternatives: Use one shared latency number for import, PDF, and model calls.
Fail P01 on a relative p95 against trunk code that does not exist.
Leave PDF inside the import wall-time budget.
